item.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
item.description: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

item.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
item.description: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.
item.content:encoded:
Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.

item.title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
item.description: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

item.title: New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe
item.description: In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

item.title: ChatGPT has a feature to help those in crisis. But where can you find it?
item.description: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

item.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
item.description: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

item.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
item.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

item.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway
item.description: Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.

item.title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
item.description: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.
